name: Salesforce
description: Pinned Salesforce REST CRM records, custom scalar fields, metadata and bounded collections.

permissions.description: Makes explicitly scoped HTTPS Salesforce REST requests using an externally supplied OAuth token; confirmed writes can alter CRM records. No token acquisition or refresh.

definitions.name: List sObjects (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Salesforce REST API v68.0. List sObjects. One request only, no pagination following, retries or OAuth refresh. Token from RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or named secret. Exact HTTPS instance origin required; redirects rejected. Total deadline 50..30000 ms, response 1 MiB, mutation payload 128 KiB, query page 2000 records, collections 200. Custom fields remain separate scalar maps; unknown standard response fields are omitted. definitions.documentation:
Salesforce REST API v68.0. Describe sObject. One request only, no pagination following, retries or OAuth refresh. Token from RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or named secret. Exact HTTPS instance origin required; redirects rejected. Total deadline 50..30000 ms, response 1 MiB, mutation payload 128 KiB, query page 2000 records, collections 200. Custom fields remain separate scalar maps; unknown standard response fields are omitted. Exact HTTPS instance origin required; redirects rejected. Total deadline 50..30000 ms, response 1 MiB, mutation payload 128 KiB, query page 2000 records, collections 200. Custom fields remain separate scalar maps; unknown standard response fields are omitted. definitions.documentation:
Salesforce REST API v68.0. Search Dynamic Scalar Fields. One request only, no pagination following, retries or OAuth refresh. Token from RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or named secret. Exact HTTPS instance origin required; redirects rejected. Total deadline 50..30000 ms, response 1 MiB, mutation payload 128 KiB, query page 2000 records, collections 200. Custom fields remain separate scalar maps; unknown standard response fields are omitted. definitions.documentation:

Exact HTTPS instance origin required; redirects rejected. Total deadline 50..30000 ms, response 1 MiB, mutation payload 128 KiB, query page 2000 records, collections 200. definitions.documentation:
Salesforce REST API v68.0. Create Dynamic Scalar Fields. One request only, no pagination following, retries or OAuth refresh. Token from RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or named secret. Exact HTTPS instance origin required; redirects rejected. Total deadline 50..30000 ms, response 1 MiB, mutation payload 128 KiB, query page 2000 records, collections 200. Custom fields remain separate scalar maps; unknown standard response fields are omitted. Requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation=SALESFORCE_CREATE and $retries=0. An interrupted write has an uncertain outcome; reconcile before retrying. definitions.name: Update Dynamic Scalar Fields (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Salesforce REST API v68.0. Update Dynamic Scalar Fields. One request only, no pagination following, retries or OAuth refresh. Token from RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or named secret. Exact HTTPS instance origin required; redirects rejected. Total deadline 50..30000 ms, response 1 MiB, mutation payload 128 KiB, query page 2000 records, collections 200. Custom fields remain separate scalar maps; unknown standard response fields are omitted. Requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation=SALESFORCE_UPDATE and $retries=0. An interrupted write has an uncertain outcome; reconcile before retrying. definitions.name: Upsert Dynamic Scalar Fields (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Salesforce REST API v68.0. Upsert Dynamic Scalar Fields. One request only, no pagination following, retries or OAuth refresh. Token from RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or named secret. Exact HTTPS instance origin required; redirects rejected. Total deadline 50..30000 ms, response 1 MiB, mutation payload 128 KiB, query page 2000 records, collections 200. Custom fields remain separate scalar maps; unknown standard response fields are omitted. Requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation=SALESFORCE_UPSERT and $retries=0. An interrupted write has an uncertain outcome; reconcile before retrying. definitions.name: Delete Dynamic Scalar Fields (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Salesforce REST API v68.0. Delete Dynamic Scalar Fields. One request only, no pagination following, retries or OAuth refresh. Token from RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or named secret. Exact HTTPS instance origin required; redirects rejected. Total deadline 50..30000 ms, response 1 MiB, mutation payload 128 KiB, query page 2000 records, collections 200. Custom fields remain separate scalar maps; unknown standard response fields are omitted. Requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation=SALESFORCE_DELETE and $retries=0. An interrupted write has an uncertain outcome; reconcile before retrying. definitions.documentation:

Exact HTTPS instance origin required; redirects rejected. Total deadline 50..30000 ms, response 1 MiB, mutation payload 128 KiB, query page 2000 records, collections 200. definitions.name: Create Account (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Salesforce REST API v68.0. Create Account. One request only, no pagination following, retries or OAuth refresh. Token from RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or named secret. Exact HTTPS instance origin required; redirects rejected. Total deadline 50..30000 ms, response 1 MiB, mutation payload 128 KiB, query page 2000 records, collections 200. Custom fields remain separate scalar maps; unknown standard response fields are omitted. Requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation=SALESFORCE_CREATE and $retries=0. An interrupted write has an uncertain outcome; reconcile before retrying. definitions.documentation:
Salesforce REST API v68.0. Upsert Account. One request only, no pagination following, retries or OAuth refresh. Token from RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or named secret. Exact HTTPS instance origin required; redirects rejected. Total deadline 50..30000 ms, response 1 MiB, mutation payload 128 KiB, query page 2000 records, collections 200. Custom fields remain separate scalar maps; unknown standard response fields are omitted. Requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation=SALESFORCE_UPSERT and $retries=0. An interrupted write has an uncertain outcome; reconcile before retrying. Salesforce REST API v68.0. Delete Account. One request only, no pagination following, retries or OAuth refresh. Token from RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or named secret. Exact HTTPS instance origin required; redirects rejected. Total deadline 50..30000 ms, response 1 MiB, mutation payload 128 KiB, query page 2000 records, collections 200. Custom fields remain separate scalar maps; unknown standard response fields are omitted. Requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation=SALESFORCE_DELETE and $retries=0. An interrupted write has an uncertain outcome; reconcile before retrying. definitions.name: Get Contact (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Salesforce REST API v68.0. Get Contact. One request only, no pagination following, retries or OAuth refresh. Token from RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or named secret. Exact HTTPS instance origin required; redirects rejected. Total deadline 50..30000 ms, response 1 MiB, mutation payload 128 KiB, query page 2000 records, collections 200. Custom fields remain separate scalar maps; unknown standard response fields are omitted. Exact HTTPS instance origin required; redirects rejected. Total deadline 50..30000 ms, response 1 MiB, mutation payload 128 KiB, query page 2000 records, collections 200. Exact HTTPS instance origin required; redirects rejected. Total deadline 50..30000 ms, response 1 MiB, mutation payload 128 KiB, query page 2000 records, collections 200. definitions.name: Create Contact (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Salesforce REST API v68.0. Create Contact. One request only, no pagination following, retries or OAuth refresh. Token from RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or named secret. Exact HTTPS instance origin required; redirects rejected. Total deadline 50..30000 ms, response 1 MiB, mutation payload 128 KiB, query page 2000 records, collections 200. Custom fields remain separate scalar maps; unknown standard response fields are omitted. Requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation=SALESFORCE_CREATE and $retries=0. An interrupted write has an uncertain outcome; reconcile before retrying. Sources: https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-list.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-sobject-describe.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-query.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-queryall.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-search.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-sobject-retrieve.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-sobject-upsert.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-sobject-relationships.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-composite-sobjects-collections-retrieve.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-composite-sobjects-collections-create.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-composite-sobjects-collections-update.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-composite-sobjects-collections-upsert.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-composite-sobjects-collections-delete.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-limits.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/field-reference/references/field-reference/

definitions.documentation:
Salesforce REST API v68.0. Update Contact. One request only, no pagination following, retries or OAuth refresh. Token from RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or named secret. Exact HTTPS instance origin required; redirects rejected. Total deadline 50..30000 ms, response 1 MiB, mutation payload 128 KiB, query page 2000 records, collections 200. Custom fields remain separate scalar maps; unknown standard response fields are omitted. Requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation=SALESFORCE_UPDATE and $retries=0. An interrupted write has an uncertain outcome; reconcile before retrying. definitions.documentation:
Salesforce REST API v68.0. Upsert Contact. One request only, no pagination following, retries or OAuth refresh. Token from RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or named secret. Exact HTTPS instance origin required; redirects rejected. Total deadline 50..30000 ms, response 1 MiB, mutation payload 128 KiB, query page 2000 records, collections 200. Custom fields remain separate scalar maps; unknown standard response fields are omitted. Requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation=SALESFORCE_UPSERT and $retries=0. An interrupted write has an uncertain outcome; reconcile before retrying. Salesforce REST API v68.0. Query Lead. One request only, no pagination following, retries or OAuth refresh. Token from RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or named secret. definitions.name: Create Lead (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Salesforce REST API v68.0. Create Lead. One request only, no pagination following, retries or OAuth refresh. Token from RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or named secret. Exact HTTPS instance origin required; redirects rejected. Total deadline 50..30000 ms, response 1 MiB, mutation payload 128 KiB, query page 2000 records, collections 200. Custom fields remain separate scalar maps; unknown standard response fields are omitted. Requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation=SALESFORCE_CREATE and $retries=0. An interrupted write has an uncertain outcome; reconcile before retrying. definitions.name: Update Lead (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Salesforce REST API v68.0. Update Lead. One request only, no pagination following, retries or OAuth refresh. Token from RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or named secret. Exact HTTPS instance origin required; redirects rejected. Total deadline 50..30000 ms, response 1 MiB, mutation payload 128 KiB, query page 2000 records, collections 200. Custom fields remain separate scalar maps; unknown standard response fields are omitted. Requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation=SALESFORCE_UPDATE and $retries=0. An interrupted write has an uncertain outcome; reconcile before retrying. Sources: https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-list.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-sobject-describe.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-query.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-queryall.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-search.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-sobject-retrieve.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-sobject-upsert.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-sobject-relationships.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-composite-sobjects-collections-retrieve.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-composite-sobjects-collections-create.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-composite-sobjects-collections-update.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-composite-sobjects-collections-upsert.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-composite-sobjects-collections-delete.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-limits.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/field-reference/references/field-reference/

definitions.name: Upsert Lead (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Salesforce REST API v68.0. Upsert Lead. One request only, no pagination following, retries or OAuth refresh. Token from RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or named secret. Exact HTTPS instance origin required; redirects rejected. Total deadline 50..30000 ms, response 1 MiB, mutation payload 128 KiB, query page 2000 records, collections 200. Custom fields remain separate scalar maps; unknown standard response fields are omitted. Requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation=SALESFORCE_UPSERT and $retries=0. An interrupted write has an uncertain outcome; reconcile before retrying. definitions.documentation:
Salesforce REST API v68.0. Get Opportunity. One request only, no pagination following, retries or OAuth refresh. Token from RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or named secret. Exact HTTPS instance origin required; redirects rejected. Total deadline 50..30000 ms, response 1 MiB, mutation payload 128 KiB, query page 2000 records, collections 200. Custom fields remain separate scalar maps; unknown standard response fields are omitted. Exact HTTPS instance origin required; redirects rejected. Total deadline 50..30000 ms, response 1 MiB, mutation payload 128 KiB, query page 2000 records, collections 200. definitions.name: Create Opportunity (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Salesforce REST API v68.0. Create Opportunity. One request only, no pagination following, retries or OAuth refresh. Token from RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or named secret. Exact HTTPS instance origin required; redirects rejected. Total deadline 50..30000 ms, response 1 MiB, mutation payload 128 KiB, query page 2000 records, collections 200. Custom fields remain separate scalar maps; unknown standard response fields are omitted. Requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation=SALESFORCE_CREATE and $retries=0. An interrupted write has an uncertain outcome; reconcile before retrying. Sources: https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-list.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-sobject-describe.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-query.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-queryall.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-search.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-sobject-retrieve.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-sobject-upsert.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-sobject-relationships.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-composite-sobjects-collections-retrieve.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-composite-sobjects-collections-create.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-composite-sobjects-collections-update.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-composite-sobjects-collections-upsert.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-composite-sobjects-collections-delete.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-limits.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/field-reference/references/field-reference/

definitions.name: Update Opportunity (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Salesforce REST API v68.0. Update Opportunity. One request only, no pagination following, retries or OAuth refresh. Token from RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or named secret. Exact HTTPS instance origin required; redirects rejected. Total deadline 50..30000 ms, response 1 MiB, mutation payload 128 KiB, query page 2000 records, collections 200. Custom fields remain separate scalar maps; unknown standard response fields are omitted. Requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation=SALESFORCE_UPDATE and $retries=0. An interrupted write has an uncertain outcome; reconcile before retrying. Sources: https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-list.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-sobject-describe.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-query.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-queryall.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-search.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-sobject-retrieve.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-sobject-upsert.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-sobject-relationships.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-composite-sobjects-collections-retrieve.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-composite-sobjects-collections-create.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-composite-sobjects-collections-update.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-composite-sobjects-collections-upsert.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-composite-sobjects-collections-delete.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-limits.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/field-reference/references/field-reference/

definitions.documentation:
Salesforce REST API v68.0. Upsert Opportunity. One request only, no pagination following, retries or OAuth refresh. Token from RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or named secret. Exact HTTPS instance origin required; redirects rejected. Total deadline 50..30000 ms, response 1 MiB, mutation payload 128 KiB, query page 2000 records, collections 200. Custom fields remain separate scalar maps; unknown standard response fields are omitted. Requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation=SALESFORCE_UPSERT and $retries=0. An interrupted write has an uncertain outcome; reconcile before retrying. definitions.documentation:
Salesforce REST API v68.0. Delete Opportunity. One request only, no pagination following, retries or OAuth refresh. Token from RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or named secret. Exact HTTPS instance origin required; redirects rejected. Total deadline 50..30000 ms, response 1 MiB, mutation payload 128 KiB, query page 2000 records, collections 200. Custom fields remain separate scalar maps; unknown standard response fields are omitted. Requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation=SALESFORCE_DELETE and $retries=0. An interrupted write has an uncertain outcome; reconcile before retrying. definitions.documentation:
Salesforce REST API v68.0. Get Case. One request only, no pagination following, retries or OAuth refresh. Token from RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or named secret. Exact HTTPS instance origin required; redirects rejected. Total deadline 50..30000 ms, response 1 MiB, mutation payload 128 KiB, query page 2000 records, collections 200. Custom fields remain separate scalar maps; unknown standard response fields are omitted. Exact HTTPS instance origin required; redirects rejected. Total deadline 50..30000 ms, response 1 MiB, mutation payload 128 KiB, query page 2000 records, collections 200. definitions.documentation:
Salesforce REST API v68.0. QueryAll Case. One request only, no pagination following, retries or OAuth refresh. Token from RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or named secret. Exact HTTPS instance origin required; redirects rejected. Total deadline 50..30000 ms, response 1 MiB, mutation payload 128 KiB, query page 2000 records, collections 200. Custom fields remain separate scalar maps; unknown standard response fields are omitted. definitions.name: Create Case (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Salesforce REST API v68.0. Create Case. One request only, no pagination following, retries or OAuth refresh. Token from RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or named secret. Exact HTTPS instance origin required; redirects rejected. Total deadline 50..30000 ms, response 1 MiB, mutation payload 128 KiB, query page 2000 records, collections 200. Custom fields remain separate scalar maps; unknown standard response fields are omitted. Requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation=SALESFORCE_CREATE and $retries=0. An interrupted write has an uncertain outcome; reconcile before retrying. Sources: https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-list.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-sobject-describe.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-query.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-queryall.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-search.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-sobject-retrieve.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-sobject-upsert.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-sobject-relationships.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-composite-sobjects-collections-retrieve.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-composite-sobjects-collections-create.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-composite-sobjects-collections-update.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-composite-sobjects-collections-upsert.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-composite-sobjects-collections-delete.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-limits.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/field-reference/references/field-reference/

definitions.name: Update Case (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Salesforce REST API v68.0. Update Case. One request only, no pagination following, retries or OAuth refresh. Token from RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or named secret. Exact HTTPS instance origin required; redirects rejected. Total deadline 50..30000 ms, response 1 MiB, mutation payload 128 KiB, query page 2000 records, collections 200. Custom fields remain separate scalar maps; unknown standard response fields are omitted. Requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation=SALESFORCE_UPDATE and $retries=0. An interrupted write has an uncertain outcome; reconcile before retrying. Sources: https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-list.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-sobject-describe.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-query.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-queryall.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-search.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-sobject-retrieve.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-sobject-upsert.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-sobject-relationships.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-composite-sobjects-collections-retrieve.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-composite-sobjects-collections-create.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-composite-sobjects-collections-update.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-composite-sobjects-collections-upsert.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-composite-sobjects-collections-delete.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-limits.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/field-reference/references/field-reference/

definitions.name: Upsert Case (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Salesforce REST API v68.0. Upsert Case. One request only, no pagination following, retries or OAuth refresh. Token from RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or named secret. Exact HTTPS instance origin required; redirects rejected. Total deadline 50..30000 ms, response 1 MiB, mutation payload 128 KiB, query page 2000 records, collections 200. Custom fields remain separate scalar maps; unknown standard response fields are omitted. Requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation=SALESFORCE_UPSERT and $retries=0. An interrupted write has an uncertain outcome; reconcile before retrying. Sources: https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-list.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-sobject-describe.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-query.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-queryall.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-search.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-sobject-retrieve.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-sobject-upsert.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-sobject-relationships.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-composite-sobjects-collections-retrieve.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-composite-sobjects-collections-create.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-composite-sobjects-collections-update.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-composite-sobjects-collections-upsert.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-composite-sobjects-collections-delete.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-limits.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/field-reference/references/field-reference/

definitions.documentation:
Salesforce REST API v68.0. Delete Case. One request only, no pagination following, retries or OAuth refresh. Token from RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or named secret. Exact HTTPS instance origin required; redirects rejected. Total deadline 50..30000 ms, response 1 MiB, mutation payload 128 KiB, query page 2000 records, collections 200. Custom fields remain separate scalar maps; unknown standard response fields are omitted. Requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation=SALESFORCE_DELETE and $retries=0. An interrupted write has an uncertain outcome; reconcile before retrying. definitions.name: Get Task (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Salesforce REST API v68.0. Get Task. One request only, no pagination following, retries or OAuth refresh. Token from RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or named secret. Exact HTTPS instance origin required; redirects rejected. Total deadline 50..30000 ms, response 1 MiB, mutation payload 128 KiB, query page 2000 records, collections 200. Custom fields remain separate scalar maps; unknown standard response fields are omitted. definitions.documentation:
Salesforce REST API v68.0. Query Task. One request only, no pagination following, retries or OAuth refresh. Token from RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or named secret. Exact HTTPS instance origin required; redirects rejected. Total deadline 50..30000 ms, response 1 MiB, mutation payload 128 KiB, query page 2000 records, collections 200. Custom fields remain separate scalar maps; unknown standard response fields are omitted. definitions.name: Create Task (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Salesforce REST API v68.0. Create Task. One request only, no pagination following, retries or OAuth refresh. Token from RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or named secret. Exact HTTPS instance origin required; redirects rejected. Total deadline 50..30000 ms, response 1 MiB, mutation payload 128 KiB, query page 2000 records, collections 200. Custom fields remain separate scalar maps; unknown standard response fields are omitted. Requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation=SALESFORCE_CREATE and $retries=0. An interrupted write has an uncertain outcome; reconcile before retrying. definitions.documentation:
Salesforce REST API v68.0. Upsert Task. One request only, no pagination following, retries or OAuth refresh. Token from RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or named secret. Exact HTTPS instance origin required; redirects rejected. Total deadline 50..30000 ms, response 1 MiB, mutation payload 128 KiB, query page 2000 records, collections 200. Custom fields remain separate scalar maps; unknown standard response fields are omitted. Requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation=SALESFORCE_UPSERT and $retries=0. An interrupted write has an uncertain outcome; reconcile before retrying. Exact HTTPS instance origin required; redirects rejected. Total deadline 50..30000 ms, response 1 MiB, mutation payload 128 KiB, query page 2000 records, collections 200. Custom fields remain separate scalar maps; unknown standard response fields are omitted. Requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation=SALESFORCE_DELETE and $retries=0. definitions.documentation:
Salesforce REST API v68.0. Get Event. One request only, no pagination following, retries or OAuth refresh. Token from RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or named secret. Exact HTTPS instance origin required; redirects rejected. Total deadline 50..30000 ms, response 1 MiB, mutation payload 128 KiB, query page 2000 records, collections 200. Custom fields remain separate scalar maps; unknown standard response fields are omitted. definitions.documentation:
Salesforce REST API v68.0. Query Event. One request only, no pagination following, retries or OAuth refresh. Token from RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or named secret. Exact HTTPS instance origin required; redirects rejected. Total deadline 50..30000 ms, response 1 MiB, mutation payload 128 KiB, query page 2000 records, collections 200. Custom fields remain separate scalar maps; unknown standard response fields are omitted. definitions.documentation:
Salesforce REST API v68.0. QueryAll Event. One request only, no pagination following, retries or OAuth refresh. Token from RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or named secret. Exact HTTPS instance origin required; redirects rejected. Total deadline 50..30000 ms, response 1 MiB, mutation payload 128 KiB, query page 2000 records, collections 200. Custom fields remain separate scalar maps; unknown standard response fields are omitted. definitions.name: Create Event (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Salesforce REST API v68.0. Create Event. One request only, no pagination following, retries or OAuth refresh. Token from RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or named secret. Exact HTTPS instance origin required; redirects rejected. Total deadline 50..30000 ms, response 1 MiB, mutation payload 128 KiB, query page 2000 records, collections 200. Custom fields remain separate scalar maps; unknown standard response fields are omitted. Requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation=SALESFORCE_CREATE and $retries=0. An interrupted write has an uncertain outcome; reconcile before retrying. Sources: https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-list.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-sobject-describe.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-query.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-queryall.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-search.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-sobject-retrieve.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-sobject-upsert.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-sobject-relationships.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-composite-sobjects-collections-retrieve.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-composite-sobjects-collections-create.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-composite-sobjects-collections-update.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-composite-sobjects-collections-upsert.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-composite-sobjects-collections-delete.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-limits.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/field-reference/references/field-reference/

definitions.name: Update Event (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Salesforce REST API v68.0. Update Event. One request only, no pagination following, retries or OAuth refresh. Token from RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or named secret. Exact HTTPS instance origin required; redirects rejected. Total deadline 50..30000 ms, response 1 MiB, mutation payload 128 KiB, query page 2000 records, collections 200. Custom fields remain separate scalar maps; unknown standard response fields are omitted. Requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation=SALESFORCE_UPDATE and $retries=0. An interrupted write has an uncertain outcome; reconcile before retrying. Sources: https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-list.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-sobject-describe.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-query.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-queryall.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-search.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-sobject-retrieve.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-sobject-upsert.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-sobject-relationships.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-composite-sobjects-collections-retrieve.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-composite-sobjects-collections-create.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-composite-sobjects-collections-update.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-composite-sobjects-collections-upsert.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-composite-sobjects-collections-delete.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-rest/guide/resources-limits.html https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/field-reference/references/field-reference/

definitions.name: Upsert Event (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Salesforce REST API v68.0. Upsert Event. One request only, no pagination following, retries or OAuth refresh. Token from RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or named secret. Exact HTTPS instance origin required; redirects rejected. Total deadline 50..30000 ms, response 1 MiB, mutation payload 128 KiB, query page 2000 records, collections 200. Custom fields remain separate scalar maps; unknown standard response fields are omitted. Requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation=SALESFORCE_UPSERT and $retries=0. An interrupted write has an uncertain outcome; reconcile before retrying. definitions.name: Delete Event (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Salesforce REST API v68.0. Delete Event. One request only, no pagination following, retries or OAuth refresh. Token from RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or named secret. Exact HTTPS instance origin required; redirects rejected. Total deadline 50..30000 ms, response 1 MiB, mutation payload 128 KiB, query page 2000 records, collections 200. Custom fields remain separate scalar maps; unknown standard response fields are omitted. Requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation=SALESFORCE_DELETE and $retries=0. An interrupted write has an uncertain outcome; reconcile before retrying. Custom fields remain separate scalar maps; unknown standard response fields are omitted. Requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation=SALESFORCE_CREATE and $retries=0. An interrupted write has an uncertain outcome; reconcile before retrying. definitions.documentation:
Salesforce REST API v68.0. Upsert Campaign. One request only, no pagination following, retries or OAuth refresh. Token from RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or named secret. Exact HTTPS instance origin required; redirects rejected. Total deadline 50..30000 ms, response 1 MiB, mutation payload 128 KiB, query page 2000 records, collections 200. Custom fields remain separate scalar maps; unknown standard response fields are omitted. Requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation=SALESFORCE_UPSERT and $retries=0. An interrupted write has an uncertain outcome; reconcile before retrying. definitions.name: Update Record Collection (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Salesforce REST API v68.0. Update Record Collection. One request only, no pagination following, retries or OAuth refresh. Token from RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or named secret. Exact HTTPS instance origin required; redirects rejected. Total deadline 50..30000 ms, response 1 MiB, mutation payload 128 KiB, query page 2000 records, collections 200. Custom fields remain separate scalar maps; unknown standard response fields are omitted. Requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation=SALESFORCE_COLLECTION_UPDATE and $retries=0. An interrupted write has an uncertain outcome; reconcile before retrying. definitions.name: Upsert Record Collection (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Salesforce REST API v68.0. Upsert Record Collection. One request only, no pagination following, retries or OAuth refresh. Token from RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or named secret. Exact HTTPS instance origin required; redirects rejected. Total deadline 50..30000 ms, response 1 MiB, mutation payload 128 KiB, query page 2000 records, collections 200. Custom fields remain separate scalar maps; unknown standard response fields are omitted. Requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation=SALESFORCE_COLLECTION_UPSERT and $retries=0. An interrupted write has an uncertain outcome; reconcile before retrying. definitions.documentation:
Salesforce REST API v68.0. Delete Record Collection. One request only, no pagination following, retries or OAuth refresh. Token from RuntimeConnection.credentials.accessToken or named secret. Exact HTTPS instance origin required; redirects rejected. Total deadline 50..30000 ms, response 1 MiB, mutation payload 128 KiB, query page 2000 records, collections 200. Custom fields remain separate scalar maps; unknown standard response fields are omitted. Requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation=SALESFORCE_COLLECTION_DELETE and $retries=0. An interrupted write has an uncertain outcome; reconcile before retrying.
